sources.title: The Enneagram: A systematic review of the literature and directions for future research
sources.authors_or_organization: Joshua N. Hook; Todd W. Hall; Don E. Davis; Daryl R. Van Tongeren; Mackenzie Conner
sources.supported_use: Synthesize the empirical literature and identify mixed reliability/validity findings plus weak support for secondary constructs.
sources.limitation: The 104-sample review combines heterogeneous instruments and does not validate FermatMind, establish universal nine-factor recovery, or support deterministic individual typing.

sources.title: Personality type and work-related outcomes: An exploratory application of the Enneagram model
sources.authors_or_organization: Anna Sutton; Christopher Allinson; Helen Williams
sources.supported_use: Document that exploratory empirical applications to work-related outcomes exist.
sources.limitation: An exploratory work-context study does not establish causal effects, universal prediction, hiring suitability, or FermatMind score validity.

sources.title: Development and Validation of a Personality Type Inventory Based on Enneagram
sources.supported_use: Document development of one Turkish-language Enneagram inventory.
sources.limitation: Evidence is instrument-, language-, sample-, and study-specific; it cannot transfer to FermatMind reliability, validity, norms, percentiles, or interpretation.

sources.title: Validity and reliability of enneagram personality types and subtypes inventory in a Turkish sample
sources.authors_or_organization: Ömer Yanartaş; Cem Malakcıoğlu; İsmail Acarkan; Erdoğdu Akça
sources.supported_use: Document one Turkish self-report study operationalizing type and instinctual-subtype scales.
sources.limitation: The predominantly female, highly educated Turkish sample and instrument-specific results do not establish cross-cultural universality, subtype ontology, or FermatMind equivalence.

sources.title: The Wisdom of the Enneagram: The Complete Guide to Psychological and Spiritual Growth for the Nine Personality Types
sources.supported_use: Trace traditional nine-type, center, and wing vocabulary.
sources.limitation: A practitioner/theory text is not independent psychometric validation and cannot be sole scientific evidence.

sources.title: Character and Neurosis: An Integrative View
sources.supported_use: Trace traditional type and subtype vocabulary as theory history.
sources.limitation: Historical theory language, including clinical-sounding labels, is not contemporary diagnosis, causal evidence, or validation.

sources.title: Frozen Truity URL and intent registry
sources.authors_or_organization: FermatMind benchmark capture of public Truity surfaces
sources.supported_use: Read-only comparison of public page types, intent clusters, and structural coverage.
sources.limitation: Competitor wording and self-reported claims are not scientific evidence, FermatMind authority, superiority evidence, or permission to copy.

sources.title: FermatMind public claim boundary
sources.supported_use: Apply non-diagnostic, non-deterministic, non-predictive, and authority-boundary language.
sources.limitation: Repository policy governs product claims but is not independent scientific evidence.

sources.title: Enneagram Public Authority V2 blocked or unverified assumptions
sources.supported_use: Keep unsupported psychometrics, prediction, review identity, and release eligibility explicitly blocked.
sources.limitation: A blocked record supplies no positive evidence; Unknown remains Unknown until direct evidence and accountable approval exist.

claims.allowed_summary_en: The Enneagram is commonly presented as a nine-type framework for structured self-observation.
claims.allowed_summary_zh_cn: 九型人格通常被呈现为一种用于结构化自我观察的九类型框架。
claims.limitation: The framework label does not prove that every person has one fixed type or that nine latent factors are universally recovered.

claims.allowed_summary_en: Published Enneagram reliability and validity findings are mixed and depend on instrument, sample, language, and design.
claims.allowed_summary_zh_cn: 已发表的九型人格信度与效度结果并不一致，并取决于量表、样本、语言与研究设计。
claims.limitation: No cited result transfers automatically to FermatMind scores, norms, translations, or individual interpretations.

claims.allowed_summary_en: Some studies have explored associations between Enneagram types and work-related outcomes.
claims.allowed_summary_zh_cn: 部分研究探索了九型人格类型与工作相关结果之间的关联。
claims.limitation: Exploratory associations do not establish causation, prediction, hiring suitability, career destiny, or guaranteed outcomes.

claims.allowed_summary_en: Center groupings are traditional organizing concepts within Enneagram theory.
claims.allowed_summary_zh_cn: 中心分组是九型人格传统理论中的组织性概念。
claims.limitation: Center groupings are theory vocabulary, not independently established biological systems, diagnoses, or fixed capacities.

claims.allowed_summary_en: A wing is a traditional secondary hypothesis used to discuss variation around a core type.
claims.allowed_summary_zh_cn: 翼型是传统理论中的次级假设，用来讨论核心类型周边的差异。
claims.limitation: The systematic review found little research supporting wings; a wing remains an evidence-limited observation prompt, not a validated subtype or fixed identity.

claims.allowed_summary_en: Instinctual subtypes are traditional secondary hypotheses that some instruments operationalize for study.
claims.allowed_summary_zh_cn: 本能副型是传统理论中的次级假设，部分量表会将其操作化用于研究。
claims.limitation: One instrument-specific study does not establish universal subtype ontology, cross-cultural equivalence, diagnosis, or FermatMind validity.

claims.allowed_summary_en: Use results as structured reflection prompts, not medical diagnoses or fixed judgments about identity, ability, or future outcomes.
claims.allowed_summary_zh_cn: 把结果作为结构化反思提示，而不是医疗诊断，也不是对身份、能力或未来结果的固定判断。
claims.limitation: This product boundary does not establish scientific validity or clinical utility.

claims.allowed_summary_en: Competitor pages may inform intent comparison only.
claims.allowed_summary_zh_cn: 竞品页面只能用于意图对比。
claims.limitation: Never use competitor content as scientific evidence, FermatMind authority, endorsement, superiority evidence, or copied wording.

claims.allowed_summary_en: FermatMind-specific reliability, validity, norms, and percentiles remain Unknown.
claims.allowed_summary_zh_cn: 费马测试自身的信度、效度、常模与百分位仍为 Unknown。
claims.limitation: Do not publish validation claims without version-matched direct evidence and operator approval.

claims.allowed_summary_en: Predictive career, hiring, relationship, health, admission, income, legal, and financial outcomes are blocked.
claims.allowed_summary_zh_cn: 职业预测、录用、关系、健康、升学、收入、法律与金融结果主张均被阻断。
claims.limitation: No source in this ledger authorizes prediction, screening, diagnosis, or guaranteed outcomes.

claims.allowed_summary_en: Named human review and current release eligibility remain unverified.
claims.allowed_summary_zh_cn: 具名人工审核与当前发布资格仍未验证。
claims.limitation: Agent preparation is not human review, and a source map is not a publication or indexability gate.
